title: Tritonville road
html_source:
From the Star of the Sea end

RIP May Rafter and Gerry Nolan. Mods, please allow me to say that I will see uncle Gerry again one day on the sludge of Sandymount Strand where we went looking for waders and aunt May, I didn’t know it was the drink, I just remember being brought to your young deathbed, my dad’s hands at my shoulders, forcing me to look at you, pressing yourself against the headboard in a delirium. I thought you were dying of paleness. Above that, I remember the smile you turned to me at 15 Tritonville Road kitchen window, wide as the sunlight slabs hitting the wall beside your portrait.
